data: Sur le point d’être virés de l’émission de télévision qu’ils animent à cause d’un bad buzz retentissant, Éric & Quentin ont 48h pour créer un buzz positif et sauver leur carrière et leur dignité. (About to be fired from a television show that they host, Eric & Quentin have forty-eight hours to create a positive buzz to counteract the bad buzz that may lead to them being out of a job. Forty-eight hours to save their careers and their dignity.)
